company.name: Swifter
company.shortDescription: Swifter is a payment solutions platform designed specifically for the cannabis industry.
company.description:
Swifter is a payment solutions platform designed specifically for the cannabis industry. It aims to help companies 100x their email revenue. Regular email makes users go to a browser to take action. This leads to drop-offs. Swifter lets users build dynamic (API-linked) emails with 1-click Swift Checkout. Users can shop, book, and complete workflows, within the email with just a single click. 

The company was founded in 2020 and is based in San Francisco, California.
